title: FLOPs与实际工作：AI效率评估中复现的重要性
summary: 本文复现了α-FLOPs估算公式的原始实验，验证了原始FLOPs不适合作为执行时间指标，但发现新硬件上执行时间存在不稳定性和不连续性，α-FLOPs公式低估了这些现象。研究强调了完整复现包的必要性，并提供了自己的复现包。
summary_en: This paper replicates the α-FLOPs estimation formula experiments, confirming raw FLOPs are not a proper metric for execution time, but finding new hardware exhibits instabilities and discontinuities that the formula underestimates. It highlights the need for complete replication packages and provides one.
